## Event Overview

TheFirst-Year B.Tech Student Orientation Programmemarks the beginning of the academic journey for students admitted under theConvener QuotaandB-Categoryfor theAcademic Year 2026–2027.
Students and their parents are invited to participate in this programme to become familiar with the institute’s academic environment, infrastructure, policies, student support systems, and departmental activities.
The Orientation Programme provides an opportunity to:
- Understand MGIT’s Vision, Mission, and Institutional Values
- Meet the Principal, Heads of Departments, and Faculty Members
- Learn about academic regulations and examination procedures
- Explore campus facilities and student support services
- Understand placement, innovation, research, and extracurricular opportunities
- Interact with faculty members and department mentors

## Department Interaction Sessions

Students and parents will attend departmental sessions conducted by the respective Heads of Departments.
Activities include:
- Department Introduction
- Faculty Interaction
- Curriculum Overview
- Laboratory Facilities
- Student Clubs
- Placement & Career Guidance
- Mentor-Mentee Interaction
- Question & Answer Session

## Student Induction Programme (SIP)

Duration:03 August 2026 – 07 August 2026
The Student Induction Programme is conducted in accordance withAICTE Guidelinesto help newly admitted students successfully transition into engineering education.
The programme aims to:
- Help students adapt to the new academic environment
- Encourage interaction with faculty members and peers
- Develop confidence and communication skills
- Promote ethical values and professional behaviour
- Introduce institutional resources and student support services
- Foster holistic development through academic and extracurricular activities

## Major Themes Covered During SIP

The induction programme includes expert lectures and interactive sessions on:
- Personality Development
- Yoga, Meditation & Spirituality
- Universal Human Values
- Values, Morals & Ethics
- Psychology, Anxiety & Stress Relief
- Career Development
- Road Safety
- Environmental Awareness
- Gender Sensitization
- Indian Knowledge System
- National Service Scheme (NSS)
- Constitution of India (COI), Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cyber Security, Data Science & Entrepreneurship Development Cell (EDC)
- Games & Sports
- Department Laboratory Visits, HoD & Faculty Interaction, Student Introduction and Feedback
